## Exceptions

TypeError when `options.contentType` is given and is not a string.

RangeError when `options.contentType` is longer than 255 characters.

RateLimitedError when the subject already has the maximum number of outstanding uploads; `retryAfterSeconds` is the time until its oldest outstanding upload expires.
